summary: Cross-region chronological audit proof with timezone normalization and exception redaction policy
description: Issue summary: Customer requests an auditable proof bundle that demonstrates chronological integrity of account and admin audit events across regions (us-east, eu-west). They need UTC-canonicalized timestamps, a human-readable redaction rationale for any suppressed fields, and a cryptographic manifest that links regional checkpoints for a quarterly pen-test.
impact: Aurelia Financial requires admissible evidence for an upcoming Q1 pen-test. Lack of a clear cross-region chronology and redaction rationale will delay their compliance sign-off and may postpone go-live for a regulated feature.
environment_details: Production event store exports (immutable S3 bucket), per-region SIEM forwarders (HEC in us-east, Graylog bridge eu-west), audit-service v2.4.1, redaction-engine v1.9.0.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer requested a backfill for 2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31. 2) Export pipeline produced region-specific parquet slices with event timestamps in local timezone. 3) Customer attempted to reconcile ordering across regions and found ordering inconsistencies and missing redaction rationale entries.
logs_and_artifacts: Attached sample events provided by customer (anonymized): event_ids: [ae3f1, be7c2], sample parity manifest request. Internal logs: audit-service/2026-03-09/us-east/export.log and eu-west/export.log referenced in investigation notes.
investigation_notes:
- 2026-03-10 09:40: Support reproduced mismatch: eu-west exports contained timestamps in Europe/London local tz due to an earlier configuration oversight in the exporter.
- SRE note (2026-03-10): Found transient clock skew (NTP drift ~2.3s) on eu-west exporter host ip 10.8.4.22 between 2026-02-28 and 2026-03-02; drift compensated but left inconsistent event ordering in two micro-batches.
- Redaction-engine audit: several events had redaction applied but lacked a human-readable rationale file due to a failure in the post-processor job (job id postproc-774). The failure retried but the rationale file was never attached to the manifest.
- Verified that S3 archive contains immutable objects with version IDs for all affected slices; no data loss.
customer_communication: 2026-03-10: Customer clarified they need RFC3161 timestamps in the manifest and a per-event "reasoning.txt" for redactions. They also requested per-region checkpoint hashes and a top-level chain linking region checkpoints into a single SHA256 chain.
workaround: Provided a manual evidence bundle: UTC-normalized CSV of events for requested date range, an interim manifest listing S3 object keys and versions, and a separate redaction-rationale.txt. Bundle delivered via pre-signed S3 link (48h expiry) on 2026-03-11.
resolution_notes:
- Created a durable evidence bundle including:
  * UTC-canonicalized event export (parquet and CSV) with RFC3339 timestamps
  * Signed per-region checkpoint manifests (SHA256) with RFC3161 timestamp tokens
  * Top-level chaining manifest that references per-region checkpoints and includes a chain hash
  * redaction-rationale.csv enumerating suppressed fields, suppression reason (policy id), and reviewer id
  * instructions for SIEM mapping with timezone-aware ingest rules for Splunk/HEC
- Bundle staged to Aurelia's secure S3 share and a copy saved to the on-call evidence bucket with write-once retention policy.
postmortem_actions:
- Fix exporter config so all regions emit UTC by default (deployed 2026-03-11)
- Harden post-processor retries and add end-to-end test to ensure rationale files attach to manifests (PR linked)
- Add a daily verification job that computes cross-region checkpoint diffs and alerts on ordering anomalies (runbook created)
- Offer Aurelia a monthly automated evidence export for the rest of their contract term as a stop-gap until they adopt the automation.
next_steps: 1) Engineering to merge infra PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/7890) and deploy verification job (owner: Liam). 2) Deliver final signed evidence bundle and acceptance checklist to customer (owner: Support). 3) Schedule a joint walkthrough with Aurelia security on 2026-03-15 to demonstrate artifacts.
